most_likely_explanation: Post-gap PSF-photometry artefact on a background star whose Gaia position lies 0.2-0.4 px outside the host's stamp in all 11 quarters. The two deepest "events" (BKJD 231.44 in Q2 and 937.83 in Q10, both channel 17, 0.045 and 0.027 d after data gaps; 3251+-607 and 3568+-229 ppm) coincide with post-downlink focus/pointing settling (POS_CORR1 drifting monotonically; TPF column 0, the only column the target's PSF wing reaches and the whole KBONUS SAP aperture, drifting by -2.2% / +2.3% over 2 d while the host's columns drift 0.1-0.2%) and are anti-correlated between PSF flux (down 8 ppt / step) and SAP flux (up +18,590 / +11,152 ppm), which no loss of light can produce (quarter box depths: Q2 PSF +1459+-135 vs SAP -1067+-147 ppm; Q10 PSF +1040+-134 vs SAP -992+-147). They supply roughly half of the pipeline's 481 ppm depth. With the first 0.3 d after every gap excised (899 cadences, 2.2% of the data) the 29.43 d peak is not recoverable blind (own BLS 20-40 d: SDE 3.59 at P vs inverted-flux null top 5.94) and the residual box depth at the pre-chosen ephemeris is 272+-48 ppm (empirical SNR 5.7), below the registered stage-2 floor snr_emp_pass2_min = 7.1; per-event chi2 falls from 258/30 to 37/28. A ~270-330 ppm feature at the fixed ephemeris persists in PSF, SAP and PSF_FLAT flux across the three clean seasons and 0/1500 random phases at fixed P reach it, so a small astrophysical dip is not excluded; but it was selected on artefact-dominated data, cannot be localised (target off-stamp; season-stacked deficit SNR at the nearest pixel 0.75-2.7), and fails the pre-registered rules. The TPF host KIC 5866192 is excluded as a source (19+-35 ppm PSF, 14+-25 ppm SAP in its own KBONUS light curve). Nothing is known at the position (no KOI/TCE/EB/PS/TOI, no coherent ephemeris match field-wide, SIMBAD shows only the host).
kill_reasons: Two post-gap events (Q2 BKJD 231.44, Q10 BKJD 937.83; 0.045 and 0.027 d after gaps; both channel 17) have PSF depths 3251+-607 and 3568+-229 ppm while SAP flux at the same cadences is +18,590 and +11,152 ppm HIGH (quarter box depths Q2 PSF +1459+-135 vs SAP -1067+-147; Q10 PSF +1040+-134 vs SAP -992+-147): anti-correlated PSF/SAP excursions, not a loss of light (redteam/event_rawflux.log, redteam/lc_checks.json per_quarter)

Mechanism visible in the host TPFs: after both gaps POS_CORR1 drifts monotonically and TPF column 0 (the only column the target's PSF wing reaches; also the entire KBONUS SAP aperture) drifts -2.2% (Q2) / +2.3% (Q10) over 2 d while the host's columns drift 0.1-0.2%; the target's Gaia position maps to x = -0.22 to -0.39 px, outside the stamp, in all 11 quarters; PSFFRAC 0.52-0.69

With 0.3 d after every gap excised the signal fails the registered rules: 1.95 h box depth 272+-48 ppm, empirical SNR 5.7 < snr_emp_pass2_min 7.1; BLS 20-40 d SDE at 29.43 d = 3.59 vs inverted-flux null top 5.94 (not blind-recoverable); per-event chi2 258/30 -> 37/28; SAP depth all data -8+-56 ppm

Random-ephemeris calibration (1500 random t0 at the same period): 4.7% land >=2 events in post-gap 0.15 d windows and that subset has box-depth scatter 122 ppm with tails to ~430 ppm vs 52 ppm otherwise; survey-wide, 349 of 438 real first-screen passes lie in the 24-40 d monthly-gap class, so artefact-driven ephemerides are abundant; the pipeline's own vet.json already shows event_weighted_depth 250 ppm vs box depth 481 and event_chi2 67/30

Pixel-level localisation is impossible and shows nothing: season-stacked deficit SNR at the pixel nearest the target 2.7 / 2.5 / 1.2 / 0.75 (S0 excised / S1 / S2 / S3), max |SNR| in any pixel 2.7; in S1 a PRF template at the host fits as well as at the target (chi2 36.8 vs 36.7); grid optima scatter across the stamp (redteam/pixel_checks.json)

Independent re-derivation agrees: 29.433 d is not the top blind BLS peak (3:2 alias wins), the peak collapses to SDE 3.5-4.0 under 0.5 d / 2 d detrending, depth without the two events 185-271 ppm at SNR 3.9-4.8
surviving_strengths: A ~270-330 ppm box depth at the fixed ephemeris remains after excision in PSF (272+-48), SAP (276+-55) and PSF_FLAT (360+-52, Q10 step still in) flux, consistent across the three clean seasons (S1 299+-94, S2 334+-181, S3 325+-92 ppm; S0 168+-74); 0 of 1500 random phases at the fixed period reach 272 ppm

Not known anywhere: no KOI/TCE/Kepler-EB/PS for KIC 5866176 or the host KIC 5866192; no coherent phase-aligned ephemeris match among 176 harmonic period matches field-wide (three far-off chance hits only); five cumulative KOIs at 29.38-29.49 d misaligned by 7-21 d; 0 TOIs in a 3 arcmin box; SIMBAD shows only the host within 20 arcsec; no shared 29.43 d ephemeris among the six other pool stars peaking there

The bright TPF host KIC 5866192 is excluded as the source of any loss of light: 19+-35 ppm (PSF) / 14+-25 ppm (SAP) at the ephemeris in its own KBONUS light curve, < 2.1 e/s at 2 sigma vs 3.2-6.0 e/s lost in the target's PSF flux

No rotation alias (Lomb-Scargle power near P 0.004; best period 53 d long-term trend), no quality-flag association (8.7% in transit vs 8.7% overall), secondary 47+-53 ppm, odd/even 1.9 sigma after excision, duration 1.95-3.0 h allowed for R* 0.95 Rsun at b 0.82-0.93
checks_run: Evidence pack read: vet.json, events.csv, fold_events.png (no pixel run exists) and the independent re-derivation (rederive_summary.json, results*.json, fold_rederive.png)

Known-object search in data/known (KOI cumulative, DR25 TCE, Kepler EB Kirk+2016, PS Kepler field, keplerstellar, Kepler target list) by kepid and 3 arcmin cone; Exoplanet Archive TAP (2026-10-17) for TOIs in a 3 arcmin box and cumulative KOIs with 29.38 < P < 29.49 d; SIMBAD 20 arcsec cone; arXiv title check of Bienias & Szabo 2025 (arXiv:2501.09152) and the sibling review's transcription of its candidate list
Field-wide ephemeris/harmonic match (P, 2P, P/2, 3P/2, 2P/3, 3P, P/3, 4P, P/4; |dP/P| < 2e-3) against all KOIs and TCEs with phase alignment and coherence over the baseline
Survey-wide check of runs/poolA_main/triage_all.csv (6,365 stars) for detections near 29.43 d and harmonics with phase offsets; 24-40 d period class among first-screen passes (real and inverted)

FITS header audit per quarter (MODULE/OUTPUT/CHANNEL/SEASON, PSFFRAC, CROWDSAP, FLFRCSAP, NPIXSAP), KBONUS APERTURE_Qn masks, WCS mapping of target and host Gaia positions onto the 11 host TPFs downloaded from MAST

Own light-curve analysis (redteam/lc_checks.py, no pipeline imports): per-quarter normalisation, gap-split transit-masked 1 d running median; 66 gaps > 0.3 d; post-gap/pre-gap mean-flux profiles over all gaps and per gap; per-event local depths with gap proximity and chi2 vs constant; 1.95 h box depth with 400 random-phase errors with and without 0.3 d post-gap (and both-side) excision in PSF and SAP; 1500-trial random-ephemeris calibration counting post-gap hits; per-quarter and per-season depths (PSF, PSF-excised, SAP) with absolute e/s dips; odd/even; 200-phase scan and secondary; Lomb-Scargle 0.2-100 d both polarities; BLS 20-40 d real vs inverted, all data vs excised; quality-flag fraction in transit; duration/density/impact parameter and implied radius
KBONUS light curve of the host KIC 5866192 downloaded and folded at the ephemeris in PSF and SAP flux with random-phase errors; absolute-flux comparison with the target

Raw-flux anatomy of the two post-gap events (redteam/event_rawflux.log): target FLUX / SAP_FLUX / PSF_FLAT_FLUX, TPF column-0, total and host-column sums, POS_CORR1/2 and flux-weighted column centroid in 3 h bins from -1 to +2 d
Box depth in KBONUS PSF_FLAT_FLUX at the ephemeris and local depths of the two events in that product (redteam/psfflat_check.log)

Own pixel-level analysis on 11 host TPFs (redteam/pixel_checks.py): per-event per-pixel local linear trend, in-minus-out difference images, inverse-variance season stacks with and without the two post-gap events, deficit SNR maps, significance-weighted centroid vs Gaia positions, shifted out-of-transit-image template fits at target, at host and on a 0.25 px grid
what_would_settle_it: Nothing in the Kepler data can lift a 272+-48 ppm box at this ephemeris to the registered 7.1 empirical-SNR floor; retire the signal from the survivor list and log it as a post-gap PSF-fit false positive (edge-of-stamp background star, channel 17)

Pipeline change to register as v1.8 before any rerun (post-hoc): excise 0.3 d after every gap before computing the stage-2 depth, or require depth with and without post-gap events to agree within 2 sigma; require per-quarter PSF and SAP depth sign agreement; flag off-stamp targets (WCS position outside the stamp or PSFFRAC < 0.7) as non-localisable; expect this to affect many of the 349 first-screen passes in the 24-40 d class

If the residual is pursued anyway: season-by-season PSF re-extraction on the TPF with the target position fixed from Gaia and a free focus term, then a fold at the ephemeris, and inspection of Q12/Q17 cadences individually; not recommended
